    Gibbs Sampling for a Binomial Probit Model with sigma^2

    gibbs_binomial_probit.Rd

    Performs one Gibbs sampling iteration for a binomial probit model with latent variable augmentation (Albert & Chib 1993). Includes an update step for the variance parameter \(\sigma^2\).

    gibbs_binomial_probit(
  X,
  y,
  beta,
  Sigma_prior,
  mu_prior,
  sigma2 = 1,
  alpha_0 = 2,
  beta_0 = 2
)

    Arguments

    X

    Matrix of predictors \([n \times p]\).

    y

    Binary response vector \((0/1)\) of length \(n\).

    beta

    Current regression coefficients, length \(p\).

    Sigma_prior

    Prior covariance matrix \([p \times p]\) for \(\beta\).

    mu_prior

    Prior mean vector, length \(p\).

    sigma2

    Current value of \(\sigma^2\). Default 1.

    alpha_0

    Shape parameter of the Inv-Gamma prior on \(\sigma^2\). Default 2.

    beta_0

    Rate parameter of the Inv-Gamma prior on \(\sigma^2\). Default 2.

    Value

    A list with elements beta, sigma2, and z.

    Details

    The model is: $$y_i = 1 \text{ if } z_i > 0, \quad z_i = X_i\beta + \varepsilon_i, \quad \varepsilon_i \sim N(0,\sigma^2)$$

    Examples

    set.seed(123)
X <- matrix(rnorm(100 * 3), 100, 3)
y <- rbinom(100, 1, 0.5)
result <- gibbs_binomial_probit(X, y, rep(0, 3), diag(3), rep(0, 3))
print(result$beta)
#> [1] 0.08521504 0.14516316 0.11961608
